source_scope_notice: Oxford topic badges are NOT independent exact-sense CEFR signoff. Cambridge indexed snippets for pretty, due, worth suggest B1 but direct Cambridge page opens returned HTTP 403. All suggested Myanmar and examples are editorial proposals, not independent approvals.

records.original_english_definition: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ကွန်ပျူတာကို အလုပ်လုပ်စေသည့် ညွှန်ကြားချက်အစီအစဉ်
records.original_example_sentence: The program checks the files for errors.
records.source_supported_observation: The computer-instruction sense is British program; programme applies to other senses. Oxford computer-topic badge a2 is contextual, not an authenticated independent CEFR review.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: ကွန်ပျူတာက လုပ်ဆောင်ရမည့် အမိန့်ညွှန်ကြားချက်များပါဝင်သော ပရိုဂရမ်
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The program checks the files for errors.

records.original_english_definition: People in a community or society in general.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ပြည်သူလူထု
records.original_example_sentence: The library is open to the public.
records.source_supported_observation: The public is a collective noun referring to ordinary people, normally with the article the; Oxford permits singular or plural verb agreement. The a2 badge is a topic label.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: အများပြည်သူ၊ ပြည်သူလူထု (the public ဟု သုံးလေ့ရှိ)
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The library is open to the public.

records.original_english_definition: An institution where people study after school.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ကောလိပ်၊ အဆင့်မြင့်ပညာသင်ကျောင်း
records.original_example_sentence: My sister starts college next month.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford separates UK post-school further education and training from US college meaning a university-level degree institution. The draft definition is broad and the example is ambiguous.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: ကျောင်းပြီးနောက် ဆက်လက်ပညာသင်ကြားနိုင်သော ကောလိပ်၊ သက်မွေးပညာသင်တန်းကျောင်း
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: My sister is starting a course at a local college next month.

records.original_english_definition: A message or item shared on a website or social platform.
records.original_burmese_meaning: အွန်လိုင်းတွင် တင်ထားသော စာ သို့မဟုတ် အကြောင်းအရာ
records.original_example_sentence: Her post explained the new class schedule.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford distinguishes countable internet/blog post from uncountable British postal mail and from job post. The draft example fits internet sense. a2 appears as a topic label.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: အင်တာနက် သို့မဟုတ် လူမှုကွန်ရက်တွင် တင်ထားသော ပို့စ်၊ စာတင်ချက်
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: Her online post explained the new class schedule.

records.original_english_definition: A word or expression used with a particular meaning.
records.original_burmese_meaning: သီးသန့်အဓိပ္ပာယ်ရှိသော အသုံးအနှုန်း
records.original_example_sentence: Our teacher explained the term in simple English.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford sense 1 is a word/expression used as a name, often technical; sense 2 is a school term. A b1 education-topic badge occurs on school-term sense, not evidence for the draft terminology sense.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: သီးခြားအဓိပ္ပာယ်ဖြင့် သုံးသော ဝေါဟာရ၊ အသုံးအနှုန်း
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: Our teacher explained the scientific term in simple English.

records.original_example_sentence: The new instructions are pretty clear.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford adverb is rather informal and means fairly/to some extent, distinct from pretty adjective (attractive). Cambridge publisher-indexed adverb B1 versus draft A2 is a review lead; Cambridge direct open returned HTTP 403.
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The instructions are pretty clear, but I still have one question.

records.original_english_definition: Expected or arranged to happen at a particular time.
records.original_burmese_meaning: သတ်မှတ်ချိန်တွင် ဖြစ်ရန်ရှိသော
records.original_example_sentence: The next bus is due in ten minutes.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford expected/arranged sense is predicative, as in the next train is due; separate from due to meaning caused by, payment due and in due course. Cambridge publisher-indexed expected sense B1 versus draft A2 is a review lead; direct Cambridge returned HTTP 403.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: သတ်မှတ်ထားသော အချိန်တွင် ရောက်ရန်၊ ဖြစ်ရန် မျှော်မှန်းထားသော
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The next bus is due in ten minutes.

records.original_english_definition: Having a particular value in money.
records.original_example_sentence: This old coin is worth ten dollars.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford worth adjective is predicative and preposition-like, followed by value, noun or -ing; monetary value differs from worthwhile-action sense. Cambridge publisher-indexed money sense B1 versus draft A2 is a review lead; Cambridge direct returned HTTP 403.
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: This old coin is worth ten dollars.
